m5.intro: Module 5 was measured on two published datasets with the current engine (version of 3 November). RSIID: 60 pristine scientific figures from openly licensed repositories, from which copies and copy-moves are generated the way the RSIID and BINDER datasets were built. BioFors (Sabir et al., ICCV 2021): real figure panels from 60 published papers annotated by an image-integrity expert (Bik).

full.line: Demonstration manuscript: every module ran in 117 s; recommendation "Investigate before any further processing"; editor and author versions correct
full.text: test/audit-full.js uploads the demonstration manuscript (planted problems in every module) and checks the combined report. On 4 November 2026 it finished in 117 seconds. Bibliography: 2 verified, 1 miscited, 1 retracted of 7, with 3 not confirmed (as planted). PJPS style: 57% compliant, 3 references to fix. Citations: 1 missing, 1 uncited. Paper mill: HIGH (score 20; AI leftovers, tortured phrases, template wording, cell lines). Similarity: 26%. Novelty: 49/100. Recommendation: "Investigate before any further processing". The editor version (Word) includes the confidential paper-mill and image sections; the author version leaves them out. Version history by manuscript ID, Super Admin functions, editor permissions and duplicate-account protection also passed. Images are analysed in the browser, so this server-side audit does not exercise Module 5 (section 7 does).
